title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 1,301–1,350 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: There are several pediatric and dental clinics on this street.
examples.zh: 這條街上有好幾家小兒科與牙醫診所。

examples.en: She went to the walk-in clinic for a quick flu checkup.
examples.zh: 她去了免預約門診診所進行快速流感檢查。

examples.en: The community health clinic provides free vaccinations for senior citizens.
examples.zh: 社區衛生診所為年長者提供免費疫苗接種。

examples.en: National Taiwan University Hospital is a premier medical center.
examples.zh: 台大醫院是首屈一指的醫療中心。

examples.en: He spent two weeks in the hospital recovering from knee surgery.
examples.zh: 他在醫院住了兩週以從膝蓋手術中康復。

examples.en: Volunteers visited children in the hospital ward to read bedtime stories.
examples.zh: 志工們前往醫院病房探訪孩童並朗讀睡前故事。

examples.en: The injured driver was rushed to the hospital emergency room.
examples.zh: 受傷的駕駛被緊急送往醫院急診室。

examples.en: Emergency rooms prioritize treatment based on the severity of each case.
examples.zh: 急診室根據每個病患病情的嚴重程度來優先安排治療順序。

examples.en: Doctors and nurses in the emergency room work tirelessly under high pressure.
examples.zh: 急診室的醫師與護理師在高壓環境下不知疲倦地工作。

examples.en: The nurse checked the patient's vitals every two hours.
examples.zh: 護理師每兩小時測量一次病人的生命體徵。

examples.en: Be patient with beginners as they learn complex new skills.
examples.zh: 當初學者在學習複雜新技能時，請對他們保持耐心。

examples.en: The hospital treats thousands of outpatients every single week.
examples.zh: 這家醫院每週治療數以千計的門診病人。

examples.en: Consult a licensed physician if your symptoms persist.
examples.zh: 如果症狀持續未消，請諮詢合格的執業醫師。

examples.en: Dr. Chang is a well-respected family physician in our town.
examples.zh: 張醫師是我們鎮上備受尊敬的家庭醫學科醫師。

examples.en: The attending physician discussed the test results with the patient's family.
examples.zh: 主治醫師向病患家屬詳細說明了檢驗結果。

examples.en: The skilled surgeon performed the heart surgery successfully.
examples.zh: 技術精湛的外科醫師成功完成了心臟手術。

examples.en: It takes years of rigorous training to qualify as an orthopedic surgeon.
examples.zh: 經過多年嚴格培訓才能取得骨科外科醫師資格。

examples.en: The chief surgeon explained the surgical risks clearly before the operation.
examples.zh: 外科主任在動刀前清楚說明了手術風險。

examples.en: Visit the dentist twice a year for regular teeth cleaning.
examples.zh: 每年看兩次牙醫進行定期洗牙檢查。

examples.en: Children are often terrified of visiting the dental clinic.
examples.zh: 小朋友通常很害怕去看牙醫門診。

examples.en: The dentist filled the tooth cavity gently without causing much pain.
examples.zh: 牙醫溫柔地幫蛀牙補牙，幾乎沒引起什麼痛楚。

examples.en: Dedicated nurses provide compassionate care around the clock.
examples.zh: 敬業的護理師提供全天候無微不至的照護。

examples.en: The school nurse treated the scraped knee of the crying student.
examples.zh: 學校保健護理師幫哭泣學生的擦傷膝蓋敷藥處理。

examples.en: She nursed her sick mother back to complete health through patience.
examples.zh: 她耐心地照料生病的母親直至其完全康復。

examples.en: Taiwan's National Health Insurance system is globally acclaimed.
examples.zh: 台灣的全民健保制度受到全球高度讚譽。

examples.en: National Health Insurance ensures that all citizens have access to affordable healthcare.
examples.zh: 全民健康保險確保全體國民都能獲得負擔得起的醫療服務。

examples.en: Most prescription drugs and clinic visits are covered under National Health Insurance.
examples.zh: 大多數處方藥物與門診診療皆享有全民健保給付。

examples.en: Present your health insurance card at the clinic registration desk.
examples.zh: 在診所掛號櫃檯出示您的健保卡。

examples.en: Remember to bring your chip-enabled health insurance card to the pharmacy.
examples.zh: 前往藥局領藥時請記得攜帶晶片健保卡。

examples.en: If you lose your health insurance card, you can apply for a replacement online.
examples.zh: 若遺失健保卡，您可以透過線上申辦補發。

examples.en: I made a dental appointment for Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我預約了週四下午看牙醫。

examples.en: Please arrive ten minutes before your doctor's appointment.
examples.zh: 請在門診預約時間前十分鐘抵達。

examples.en: He had to cancel his morning appointment because of an urgent business flight.
examples.zh: 因為緊急的商務出差航班，他不得不取消了早上的預約。

examples.en: Common flu symptoms include fever, chills, and body aches.
examples.zh: 流感的常見症狀包括發燒、畏寒及全身痠痛。

examples.en: Early detection of symptoms improves the chances of successful recovery.
examples.zh: 及早察覺症狀徵兆能大幅提高順利康復的機率。

examples.en: Rising inflation is a symptom of broader macroeconomic instability.
examples.zh: 通膨上升是更廣泛總體經濟不穩定的一種表徵徵兆。

examples.en: Staring at screens for too long often causes a headache.
examples.zh: 盯著螢幕太久經常會引起頭痛。

examples.en: She took two aspirin tablets to relieve her throbbing headache.
examples.zh: 她吃了兩顆阿斯匹靈藥錠來舒緩劇烈陣痛的頭痛。

examples.en: Solving this unexpected server bug has been a real headache for the team.
examples.zh: 解決這個突發的伺服器錯誤對團隊而言真是個令人頭痛的大難題。

examples.en: Eating too fast may lead to an upset stomachache.
examples.zh: 吃太快可能會導致胃部不適疼痛。

examples.en: He complained of a sharp stomachache after drinking cold iced milk.
examples.zh: 喝完冰牛奶後，他抱怨胃部一陣陣劇烈絞痛。

examples.en: Herbal tea and a heating pad helped soothe her stomachache.
examples.zh: 草本茶與熱敷墊幫助緩解了她的胃部不適。

examples.en: A cavity in the molar caused a throbbing toothache.
examples.zh: 臼齒上的蛀牙導致了一陣陣劇烈的牙痛。

examples.en: I couldn't sleep all night because of an agonizing toothache.
examples.zh: 因為痛苦難耐的牙痛，我整夜都無法入睡。

examples.en: Avoid drinking ice water when you are suffering from a toothache.
examples.zh: 牙痛發作時應避免飲用冰水。

examples.en: Poor sitting posture at desks often leads to lower backache.
examples.zh: 辦公桌前不良的坐姿往往會導致下背疼痛。

examples.en: Gentle yoga stretches can alleviate chronic muscle backache.
examples.zh: 溫和的瑜珈伸展操能舒緩慢性肌肉背痛。

examples.en: Lifting heavy cardboard boxes without bending your knees will cause a backache.
examples.zh: 搬運沉重紙箱若不彎曲膝蓋將會導致背痛。

examples.en: Drink plenty of warm fluids if you have a mild fever.
examples.zh: 若有輕微發燒，請多補充溫熱水分。

examples.en: The toddler's high fever finally subsided after taking medicine.
examples.zh: 幼童的高燒在服藥後終於退了下去。

examples.en: World Cup fever swept through the entire football-loving country.
examples.zh: 世界盃狂熱風潮席捲了整個熱愛足球的國度。

examples.en: The forehead scanner measured my body temperature as 36.8°C.
examples.zh: 額溫槍測量出我的體溫為攝氏 36.8 度。

examples.en: The ambient room temperature dropped sharply overnight.
examples.zh: 室內環境氣溫在一夜之間急劇下降。

examples.en: Bake the sourdough loaf at a constant temperature of 220 degrees.
examples.zh: 將酸種麵包在攝氏兩百二十度的恆溫下烘烤。

examples.en: Use a digital ear thermometer to check the baby's fever.
examples.zh: 使用電子耳溫槍來測量小寶寶是否發燒。

examples.en: The wall thermometer indicated that the outdoor temperature was thirty degrees.
examples.zh: 壁掛式溫度計顯示室外溫度為攝氏三十度。

examples.en: Clean the thermometer probe with alcohol before and after each use.
examples.zh: 每次使用前後請用酒精棉片擦拭消毒溫度計探頭。

examples.en: Honey lemon water helps soothe an irritated sore throat.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜檸檬水有助於舒緩發炎的喉嚨痛。

examples.en: A scratchy sore throat is usually the first sign of a respiratory viral infection.
examples.zh: 喉嚨發癢疼痛通常是呼吸道病毒感染的最初徵兆。

examples.en: Gargling with warm salt water can ease the pain of a sore throat.
examples.zh: 用溫鹽水漱口有助於減緩喉嚨痛的不適感。

examples.en: Cover your mouth and nose with your elbow when you cough.
examples.zh: 咳嗽時請用手肘遮住口鼻。

examples.en: The persistent dry cough kept him awake for several nights.
examples.zh: 持續不斷的乾咳讓他好幾晚都無法入眠。

examples.en: The doctor listened to her chest while she coughed deeply.
examples.zh: 當她深咳時，醫生用聽診器仔細聆聽她的胸腔呼吸音。

examples.en: Spring pollen makes many sensitive people sneeze frequently.
examples.zh: 春天的花粉讓許多體質敏感的人頻頻打噴嚏。

examples.en: Whenever I chop fresh black pepper, I begin to sneeze.
examples.zh: 每當我切碎新鮮黑胡椒時，我就開始打噴嚏。

examples.en: People often say 'Bless you!' when someone lets out a sneeze.
examples.zh: 當有人打噴嚏時，旁人通常會說一聲「願上帝保佑你！」。

examples.en: I used several paper tissues because of my runny nose.
examples.zh: 因為流鼻水，我用掉了好幾張衛生紙。

examples.en: Antihistamines help reduce nasal discharge from a runny nose.
examples.zh: 抗組織胺藥物有助於減少流鼻水的分泌物。

examples.en: Winter cold winds can instantly give you a runny nose.
examples.zh: 冬天寒冷的刺骨寒風會讓人瞬間流鼻水。

examples.en: Warm steam inhalations can help relieve a stuffy nose.
examples.zh: 吸入溫熱水蒸氣有助於緩解鼻塞。

examples.en: It is uncomfortable to sleep with a badly stuffy nose.
examples.zh: 嚴重鼻塞時睡起覺來非常不舒服。

examples.en: A nasal spray cleared his stuffy nose in just a few minutes.
examples.zh: 通鼻噴劑在短短幾分鐘內就緩解了他的鼻塞。

examples.en: He developed an allergy to seafood such as shrimp and crabs.
examples.zh: 他對蝦蟹等海鮮類食物產生了過敏反應。

examples.en: People with peanut allergies must carry epinephrine auto-injectors.
examples.zh: 對花生過敏的人必須隨身攜帶腎上腺素自動注射器。

examples.en: Seasonal pollen allergies affect millions of individuals every spring.
examples.zh: 季節性花粉過敏每逢春季都會影響數百萬人。

examples.en: Are you allergic to any specific antibiotic medications?
examples.zh: 請問您對任何特定的抗生素藥物過敏嗎？

examples.en: She is severely allergic to bee stings and pet fur.
examples.zh: 她對蜜蜂叮咬和寵物毛髮具有嚴重的過敏反應。

examples.en: Always inform restaurant staff if you are allergic to dairy products.
examples.zh: 若您對乳製品過敏，請務必隨時告知餐廳服務人員。

examples.en: Sitting under the blazing sun made him feel dizzy.
examples.zh: 坐在烈日暴曬下讓他感到一陣頭暈。

examples.en: Standing up too abruptly from the sofa made her feel momentarily dizzy.
examples.zh: 從沙發上太猛然站起身讓她瞬間感到一陣暈眩。

examples.en: The amusement park roller coaster ride left the children dizzy and thrilled.
examples.zh: 遊樂園的雲霄飛車讓孩子們既頭暈目眩又興奮不已。

examples.en: Riding the winding mountain bus made some passengers feel nauseous.
examples.zh: 搭乘蜿蜒的山路公車讓部分乘客感到噁心想吐。

examples.en: The spoiled milk smelled sour and made me feel nauseous.
examples.zh: 酸敗的牛奶聞起來有一股酸味，令我作嘔。

examples.en: Drinking ginger tea can help reduce nauseous sensations.
examples.zh: 飲用生薑茶有助於減輕噁心反胃的感覺。

examples.en: Food poisoning caused her to vomit multiple times.
examples.zh: 食物中毒導致她連續嘔吐了好幾次。

examples.en: The flight attendant handed airsick bags to passengers who needed to vomit.
examples.zh: 空服員向需要嘔吐的乘客發放嘔吐袋。

examples.en: Contact a veterinarian immediately if your puppy begins to vomit persistently.
examples.zh: 如果你的小狗開始持續嘔吐，請立即聯繫獸醫。

examples.en: Wash raw fruits thoroughly to prevent acute diarrhea.
examples.zh: 生水果務必徹底洗淨以防急性腹瀉。

examples.en: Dehydration is the most dangerous consequence of severe diarrhea.
examples.zh: 脫水是嚴重腹瀉中最具危險性的併發症。

examples.en: Drink oral rehydration electrolyte solution if you experience travelers' diarrhea.
examples.zh: 若出現旅行者腹瀉症狀，請補充電解質口服補液鹽。

examples.en: Apply direct pressure on the cut if it continues to bleed.
examples.zh: 若傷口持續流血，請直接對傷口進行加壓。

examples.en: His gums tend to bleed whenever he brushes his teeth too aggressively.
examples.zh: 每當他刷牙太用力時，他的牙齦往往會出血。

examples.en: The wound stopped bleeding after the nurse applied a sterile gauze dressing.
examples.zh: 護理師敷上無菌紗布敷料後，傷口便停止了流血。

examples.en: Exercise regularly to keep your blood pressure in a normal range.
examples.zh: 規律運動以將血壓維持在正常範圍內。

examples.en: High blood pressure is often referred to as a silent killer.
examples.zh: 高血壓通常被稱作沈默的健康殺手。

examples.en: The clinic nurse placed an inflatable cuff on my arm to measure my blood pressure.
examples.zh: 診所護理師在我手臂上綁上充氣壓脈帶以測量血壓。

examples.en: The paramedic felt the patient's wrist pulse immediately.
examples.zh: 救護人員立即觸摸病人的手腕脈搏。

examples.en: A rapid resting pulse can be an indicator of anxiety or fever.
examples.zh: 靜止時脈搏過快可能是焦慮或發燒的指標。

examples.en: The dance music has a vibrant, energetic pulse that gets everyone moving.
examples.zh: 這首舞曲擁有充滿活力的強勁節奏律動，讓每個人都跟著搖擺。

examples.en: The doctor examined my throat with a tongue depressor.
examples.zh: 醫生用壓舌棒仔細檢查了我的喉嚨。

examples.en: Scientists examined the rock samples under powerful electron microscopes.
examples.zh: 科學家在強大的電子顯微鏡下檢視了岩石樣本。

examples.en: Customs officers thoroughly examined the cargo container for contraband.
examples.zh: 海關官員徹底檢查了貨櫃以查緝走私違禁品。

examples.en: Regular health checkups help detect medical issues early.
examples.zh: 定期健康檢查有助於早期發現潛在醫療問題。

examples.en: I booked my annual dental checkup for next Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 我預約了下週二早上的年度定期口腔健康檢查。

examples.en: Take your car in for a complete safety checkup before the long highway journey.
examples.zh: 在踏上長途公路旅程前，先把愛車送去做全面的安全車檢。

examples.en: The physician diagnosed him with the common seasonal cold.
examples.zh: 醫生診斷他患了常見的季節性感冒。

examples.en: Advanced MRI scans helped doctors diagnose the tumor accurately.
examples.zh: 先進的磁振造影掃描幫助醫生精準診斷出腫瘤。

examples.en: She was diagnosed with diabetes after a routine blood test.
examples.zh: 在一次例行驗血檢查後，她被診斷出罹患了糖尿病。

examples.en: Take this doctor's prescription to the hospital pharmacy.
examples.zh: 請拿著這張醫生處方箋到醫院藥局領藥。

examples.en: Some powerful painkillers require a valid doctor's prescription.
examples.zh: 部分強力止痛藥品必須持有合格醫師的處方箋才能購買。

examples.en: More physical exercise and less screen time is the best prescription for stress.
examples.zh: 多做體育運動並減少螢幕使用時間是舒緩壓力的最佳良方。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed some soothing cough syrup for me.
examples.zh: 醫生為我開了一些舒緩咳嗽的止咳糖漿。

examples.en: Laws strictly prescribe safety standards for school bus vehicles.
examples.zh: 法律對校車車輛的安全標準做出了嚴格的明文規範。

examples.en: The pediatrician prescribed a five-day course of antibiotics.
examples.zh: 小兒科醫師開立了一個為期五天的抗生素療程。

examples.en: Take your daily prescribed medication after breakfast.
examples.zh: 早餐後請記得按時服用每日處方藥物。

examples.en: Are you taking any other prescription medication or dietary supplements?
examples.zh: 您目前有在服用任何其他處方藥物或膳食營養品嗎？

examples.en: Never stop taking your blood pressure medication without consulting your doctor.
examples.zh: 未經醫師諮詢，切勿擅自停用降血壓藥物。

examples.en: Take one painkiller tablet every eight hours with water.
examples.zh: 每八小時配水服用一顆止痛藥錠。

examples.en: Dissolve the effervescent vitamin C tablet in a glass of water.
examples.zh: 將發泡維生素 C 藥錠溶解在一杯溫水中。

examples.en: Students can take lecture notes and read digital textbooks on their tablets.
examples.zh: 學生可以在平板電腦上記錄課堂筆記並閱讀數位教科書。

examples.en: Swallow the red vitamin capsule whole without chewing.
examples.zh: 將紅色維他命膠囊整顆吞服，切勿咀嚼。

examples.en: The space capsule safely splashed down in the Pacific Ocean.
examples.zh: 太空艙在太平洋海面上順利安全降落濺落。

examples.en: We buried a time capsule containing photos and letters behind the school.
examples.zh: 我們在學校後方埋下了一個裝有相片與信件的時空膠囊。

examples.en: The sweet cough syrup helped soothe my persistent night coughing.
examples.zh: 甜甜的止咳糖漿有助於舒緩我夜間持續的咳嗽。

examples.en: Pour warm maple syrup generously over your fluffy morning pancakes.
examples.zh: 在早晨蓬鬆的煎餅上淋上濃郁的熱楓糖漿。

examples.en: Fruit-flavored shaved ice is drizzled with sweet condensed milk and sugar syrup.
examples.zh: 水果雪花冰上淋滿了香甜煉乳與糖水糖漿。

examples.en: Apply antibacterial ointment gently over the superficial scratch.
examples.zh: 在表層抓傷處輕輕塗抹抗菌藥膏。

examples.en: Soothing herbal ointment provides fast relief from itchy mosquito bites.
examples.zh: 舒緩的草本軟膏能迅速緩解蚊蟲叮咬引起的搔癢。

examples.en: Put on sterile medical gloves before applying the medicated ointment.
examples.zh: 塗抹藥膏前請先戴上無菌醫療手套。

examples.en: Wrap the sterile elastic bandage securely around the sprained ankle.
examples.zh: 用無菌彈性繃帶將扭傷的腳踝妥善包紮。

examples.en: The paramedic carefully changed the sterile wound bandage.
examples.zh: 救護人員小心翼翼地更換了傷口的無菌繃帶敷料。

examples.en: Bandage the injured knee firmly to restrict excessive joint movement.
examples.zh: 將受傷的膝蓋緊實包紮，以限制過度的關節活動。

examples.en: Stick a waterproof band-aid over your minor finger cut.
examples.zh: 在手指的微小割傷處貼上一塊防水 OK 繃。

examples.en: Carrying a few sterile band-aids in your backpack is always smart.
examples.zh: 在背包裡常備幾片無菌 OK 繃總是明智的做法。

examples.en: Temporary price subsidies are merely a band-aid solution to deep inflation.
examples.zh: 短期的物價補貼對於深層通膨問題只不過是治標不治本的權宜之計。

examples.en: The patient received a pain-relief injection in the arm.
examples.zh: 病人在手臂上接受了一劑止痛針注射。

examples.en: Many young children cry when getting an intramuscular injection.
examples.zh: 許多幼童在接受肌肉注射時都會放聲大哭。

examples.en: The tech startup received an injection of venture capital funding.
examples.zh: 這家科技新創公司獲得了一筆創業投資資金的注入。

examples.en: Annual influenza vaccines protect vulnerable groups from serious illness.
examples.zh: 每年施打流感疫苗能保護體弱族群免於重症。

examples.en: Scientists worked around the clock to develop a reliable viral vaccine.
examples.zh: 科學家日以繼夜地研發可靠的抗病毒疫苗。

examples.en: Childhood vaccines have eradicated several dangerous infectious diseases.
examples.zh: 兒童疫苗接種已經根除了數種危險的傳染性疾病。

examples.en: Drowsiness is a common mild side effect of cold medicine.
examples.zh: 嗜睡是感冒藥常見的輕微副作用。

examples.en: The clinical trials showed minimal adverse side effects in patients.
examples.zh: 臨床試驗顯示病患身上的不良副作用微乎其微。

examples.en: Read the medicine leaflet carefully to learn about possible side effects.
examples.zh: 請仔細閱讀藥品說明書以了解可能出現的副作用。

examples.en: Get plenty of sleep to help your body recover rapidly.
examples.zh: 保持充足睡眠以幫助你的身體迅速康復。

examples.en: She managed to fully recover from pneumonia after two weeks of rest.
examples.zh: 經過兩週的充分休息，她從肺炎中完全康復。

examples.en: Police officers worked hard to recover the stolen museum artifacts.
examples.zh: 警方全力追查以找回博物館失竊的古董文物。

examples.en: The doctor advised me to get bed rest for three full days.
examples.zh: 醫生建議我必須臥床充分靜養整整三天。

examples.en: Let's rest our tired legs on that wooden park bench for a moment.
examples.zh: 我們在那張公園木椅上讓疲累的雙腿休息片刻吧。

examples.en: You eat this sandwich, and I will pack the rest of the picnic food.
examples.zh: 你吃這份三明治，我來收拾其餘的野餐食物。
